lastFeatureSummary: Shipped v0.5.10 (Improve lane): Statistics tab overhaul + a graceful SnowMap offline-retry state, batched into one release. Tester added regionNames.test.ts + area parsing tests (306 frontend tests pass). Auditor clean. Deployer published GitHub release v0.5.10 (notarized macOS universal + signed Windows installer + latest.json, all health-checked). Chronicler logged DECISIONS.md. Resolves the prior pending 'batch 0.5.10 map error-state fix with the improve lane'.
